criticism: The function withdrawForeignTokens allows anyone to withdraw any token from the contract, which can be exploited by an attacker to steal funds.
The function enablePurchasing allows anyone to enable purchasing, which can be exploited by an attacker to start the crowdsale.
The function disablePurchasing allows anyone to disable purchasing, which can be exploited by an attacker to stop the crowdsale.
The function getStats allows anyone to get the stats of the contract, which can be exploited by an attacker to steal funds.
